about: Fix Vanilla Bugs: the games' own typos the owner approved (2026-11-17), fixed in memory by "VVFP Text Fixes.dll" (native/vvfp_text_fixes) as each game's string table is filled. A fix applies only when the text the game would show is exactly `old` (so Optional Text Changes, Guardians of Isola and translations are left alone); `new` replaces it whole. Only text players see in normal play is listed (`shown`: where, static evidence from the stock executables). scripts/build_text_fixes_table.py writes native/vvfp_text_fixes/tf_fixes.inc from this file; src/vv_translations.py gives `new` as the template's English when the companion is installed. `captions`: a text the game shares between two actions, changed only at one action's own copy (`site`), when the looked-up text is exactly `old` or the caption has a translation (its own template row `key`).
